title: Supply Chain Attack on rustdecimal
technical_mechanism: -- # malicious crate `rustdecimal` The Rust Security Response WG and the crates.io team [were notified][1] on 2022-05-02 of the existence of the malicious crate `rustdecimal`; which contained malware. The crate name was intentionally similar to the name of the popular [`rust_decimal`][2] crate; hoping
